literal_meaning: কানে আঙুল দেওয়া (ear-এ finger put করা)
figurative_meaning_bn: অশ্রাব্য কিছু শুনতে না চাওয়া; না শোনার চেষ্টা
figurative_meaning_en: Refusing to hear something unpleasant; making an effort not to listen
similar_in_english: Put one's fingers in one's ears
example_sentences_in_bangla: খারাপ খবর শুনে সে কানে আঙুল দিয়ে চলে গেল।
আর কথা শোনার ইচ্ছে নেই, কানে আঙুল দাও।
example_sentences_in_english: Upon hearing the bad news, he put his fingers in his ears and walked away.
I don't want to hear anymore; put your fingers in your ears.
note: This idiom vividly illustrates the physical act of blocking sound to avoid discomfort, common in Bengali expressive language.
